title: [main]- Requests to Approve: Open Record shows wrong Requisition Worksheet batch after viewing a different batch
summary: The Req. Worksheet page now correctly displays the intended requisition batch when opened from an approval record, preventing stale batch filters from interfering with the record view.
key_points: Added GetCurrentJnlBatchName() helper to detect when page opens on a specific batch record
Overrides SaveValues-restored batch value with the record's actual batch when appropriate
Applies template filter to scope page to the correct worksheet template
Fixes case where approval record with both batch name and template name would fall through to wrong path
Prevents stale batch data from affecting the OpenJnl filter
quote: Open Record shows wrong Requisition Worksheet batch after viewing a different batch
